newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon ends suspension of Vidago - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon ends suspension of Vidago - dealers.

text.p: Shares in mineral water group Vidago will trade again on Tuesday after the Lisbon bourse lifted a suspension, dealers said.
The shares were suspended on Monday after a weekend announcement by retailer Jeronimo Martins that it was launching a public offer to buy (OPA) for the group.

Jeronimo Martins is offering some 4,270 escudos per share for Vidago. The price, which was at the upper end of analysts' expectations, valued Portugal's leading sparkling water supplier at about 15.8 billion escudos.
Vidago last closed at 3,205 escudos on November 8.
